label: Data arrival time
subgoals: Start at the launching clock edge
Add the launch clock network delay and clock-to-Q
Add every net and cell increment to the data pin

label: Data required time
subgoals: Start at the capturing clock edge
Add the capture clock network delay and the pessimism credit
Subtract the clock uncertainty and the setup time

label: Slack and what to read next
section: Slack and what to read next
subgoals: Subtract the arrival time from the required time
Locate the largest increments on a failing path
Check the start point, end point and path group against the intended constraint
